instruction: The file orders.csv has columns order_id,customer_id,units (4 rows). The file customers.csv has columns customer_id,name,region (3 rows). How many units were ordered by customers from region 'east'? Use bash with python3 to compute it. Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
